skill.name: localbiz-followup
skill.description: Organize local-business enquiries and customer follow-ups with consent-aware next actions, simple stages, and message drafts for shops and online sellers.
skill.summary: Classify customer enquiries, choose consent-aware next actions, and draft factual follow-up messages.
skill.author: falconprojectai-arch

finding_verdicts.reason: SKILL.md:15 requests a factual customer message only with a valid contact basis and uses placeholders to minimize personal data. The surrounding workflow concerns enquiry management and contains no system inspection instructions, making this a clear false positive.

content.value_statement: Small businesses can lose track of genuine enquiries and promised follow-ups. This skill organizes enquiry stages, recommends a next action, and drafts factual messages when contact is appropriate.
actual_capabilities: Ask for minimal enquiry facts, including stage, last contact, promised next step, and agreed contact channel.
Classify enquiries as new, waiting for quote, quote sent, follow-up due, booked, won, lost, or opted out.
Identify one useful next action and explain its reason.
Draft short, factual customer messages using placeholders when a valid contact basis exists.
Recommend tracking fields for consent, status, dates, notes, next actions, and opt-outs.
Suggest conservative reminder dates without repeated nudges.
limitations: Does not send messages, call customers, book appointments, charge payments, or change CRM records.
Cannot verify consent or lawful contact basis independently; the business must resolve uncertainty before marketing contact.
Cannot supply missing prices, stock levels, delivery dates, discounts, or conversation history.
The supplied file contains workflow instructions, not the companion browser app or its storage and export implementation.

use_cases.title: Track Shop Enquiries
use_cases.description: Classify product enquiries and identify the next action using confirmed stock information and agreed contact channels.

use_cases.title: Review Service Quotes
use_cases.description: Review quote stages, promised responses, and contact permissions to choose an appropriate next action.

use_cases.title: Prepare Order Enquiry Replies
use_cases.description: Draft factual replies to genuine buyer enquiries using supplied order details and placeholders instead of unnecessary personal data.

prompt_templates.title: Classify One Enquiry
prompt_templates.prompt: Help organize this enquiry for my [business type]: [summary]. Ask for missing essential facts, then suggest a stage and one next action.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: organize a single customer enquiry.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Factual Follow-Up
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this enquiry: [summary, stage, last contact, promised next step, consent/channel]. Draft a short message only if contact is appropriate. Use placeholders for personal details.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: prepare a message for manual review.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Conservative Reminder
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [enquiry details], including [consent/channel] and [promised next step]. Recommend tracking fields, one next action, and a conservative reminder date. Avoid repeated nudges.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: plan the next review without automatic reminders.

prompt_templates.title: Review Multiple Enquiries
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these anonymized enquiries: [records with dates, stages, promised steps, and consent/channel]. For each, give a stage, next action, reason, and appropriate reminder date. Flag unclear consent and opt-outs. Do not send messages or modify records.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: review several enquiries with different contact permissions.

output_examples.input: A repair customer requested a quote by email and agreed to receive it there. The confirmed quote is $80, ready today.
output: Next action: review and manually send the requested quote by email.
Reason: the quote is ready and the customer agreed to this channel.
Draft: Hello [Customer], the quote for your requested repair is $80. Please reply if you would like to proceed.
Reminder: review the record in seven days; do not send repeated follow-ups.

output_examples.input: A shop has an old product enquiry with no recorded channel agreement. The owner wants to send a promotional discount.
output: Stage: new; no later enquiry stage was supplied.
Next action: verify consent or another lawful basis before any marketing contact.
Record: enquiry source, date, consent status, next action, and any opt-out.

best_practices: Provide only essential enquiry facts and replace personal identifiers with placeholders.
Verify the contact basis and agreed channel before requesting a message draft.
Review suggested stages, message facts, and reminder dates before taking any action manually.
anti_patterns: Treating missing consent as permission to send promotional messages.
Inventing prices, stock, deadlines, discounts, or prior conversations to make a message persuasive.
Using the skill for automatic sending, repeated nudges, or unauthorized CRM changes.

faq.question: Does this skill send customer messages?
faq.answer: No. It drafts messages for review and explicitly prohibits sending messages or calling customers.

faq.question: Which enquiry stages can it use?
faq.answer: It uses new, waiting for quote, quote sent, follow-up due, booked, won, lost, and opted out.

faq.question: What happens when consent is unclear?
faq.answer: It recommends no marketing contact until the business verifies consent or another lawful basis.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide business type, enquiry summary, current stage, last contact date, promised next step, and agreed contact channel. Use placeholders for personal details.

faq.question: Does the supplied skill include a browser app?
faq.answer: No. It describes a companion app, but the supplied package contains only SKILL.md, without an app implementation.

faq.question: Can it update my CRM or schedule automatic reminders?
faq.answer: No. It recommends fields and conservative reminder dates, but does not change CRM records or provide background reminders.
